verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents built-in, first-party support for "cutting-edge model-native agents" from Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and Grok, run in its cloud sessions with a single API call. This suggests a non-DOM agent mode alongside its DOM- and Playwright-based HyperAgent path. However, the evidence never says these agents act on screenshots, use computer-use actions, or handle canvases or other UIs the DOM path can't. Screenshot output from the scrape and fetch APIs is a data format, not an action mode, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the model-native agents are screenshot/vision-based computer-use agents, any description of switching action modes, evidence of handling canvas or non-DOM UIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
